note: Round 5b ships.json (B1 to B4 and B3_per_shot) plus the round 5c tables: B2_5c and B3_5c carry both death metrics (died = track deaths, caught = batch list) and the smoker's undetected share from the track; they supersede the death and undetected columns of B2 and B3. map_cap_rows_5c holds item 7 (cap results from the cap timeline).

B1.note: edge = metres from smoke edge to contested cap edge (negative inside). teammate_pct = coverage stacked or screen. conc = concealed damage per smoke. ci = 95% by resampling clans. None = fewer than 8 smokes.

B2.note: deaths_per_100 = ships that died in or behind the smoke per 100 smokes. smoker_deaths_per_100 = the smoker itself. hurt = died or lost >= 1/3 of estimated health (health is an estimate). undetected_pct_of_covered_time = batch field (share of the time the smoker was covered by the smoke that it was undetected). undetected_pct_of_smoke_life = that time over the whole life of the smoke (activation to dispersal), computed here.

harugumo.note: Spotting cannot be attributed from the batch. Stand-ins: allied positions at the moment the smoke was fully laid (cast); nearest allied ship to each enemy the smoker damaged.

B4.note: spread_km = mean distance of a smoke from the ship's own centroid on that map (maps with 5+ smokes). edge_iqr = interquartile range of the distance to the cap edge. parked = movement label stationary (laid over under 500 m). line_1km = laid over 1 km or more. purpose entropy in bits over the primary purpose (higher = more varied). two-modes test is on log10 of the length laid: bimodality coefficient over 0.555 hints at two modes; bic_one_minus_two above 0 favours two bell curves over one; ashman_d over 2 = cleanly separated; valley_to_peak under about 0.7 = a visible dip between the two.

B3_per_shot.note: B3 per shot. A shot = one distinct firing moment and target among the smoker's shell, torpedo and airstrike events credited to its own smoke. Damage = every credited event (shells, fires, torpedoes) times its credited share. Per smoke = mean over smokes of each smoke's own-gun damage share. Positions from tracks at the firing moment (2 s samples, interpolated). Detection = the target's own track flag. Radar = the radar log lit spans.
